name: AI Usage
author: AkitaOnRails
description: Multi-provider AI plan usage and balances in a native Omarchy Quattro panel.

barWidget.description: Usage windows, reset countdowns, balances, and provider switching for every provider configured in ai-usagebar.

schema.label: Provider or account id
schema.description: Optional id from ai-usagebar usage --json (for example openai or anthropic@work). Leave blank to switch between all configured entries.

schema.label: Show usage value
schema.description: Show the selected provider's percentage or balance next to the icon in the top bar.

schema.label: Show provider name
schema.description: Show the selected provider's short code (cld, gpt, zai, agy) before the usage value, the way Waybar's {vendor_short} does. Off by default.

schema.label: Show all providers
schema.description: Show every configured provider's icon and usage in the top bar at once, instead of cycling one at a time. Off by default.
